verdict.rationale: Amplitude's own docs describe official SDKs sharing one API surface across web, mobile, server, and game engines, plus unified SDKs, Experiment SDKs, and React Native and Flutter SDKs. A Wizard CLI also detects the framework and installs the right SDK. One community comment calls integration hard but does not show the SDKs failing. missing for 10: an enumerated language/platform list with reference documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the same API surface across web, mobile, server, and game engines.
Unified SDKs provide one integration point for multiple Amplitude products.
Use Experiment SDKs to flag and test features across web, mobile, and backend.
The wizard detects your framework, installs the right SDK, adds your API key, and fires a test event.
An SDK that contains the necessary API's to use Amplitude effectively in a React Native application.
